title: Was Led to the Carnival area
content: Last night, whule dreaming of Mallworld, just before I became lucid, was led to the carnival area for the first time, by a dream character with a small dog on a leash. What is especially weird is I didn't trust the person but went with them anyway because I was curious to see the Mallworld Carnival just because I hadn't remembered "visiting" that place yet. The "side entrance" I entered with that other person felt and looked like it was built back in like the 1920s or circa 1910. What's odd too is I asked the character a question regarding a real life County Fair that is held in real life where I live, every summer. Like I literally asked them, "How is the fair started already? It's not even summertime yet." The dream person replied "oh it's always celebration time here" and then it looked to be like the leftover decorations from back in December. I only remember sections here and there, like rushing through a night market full of warm steamy foods, yet never finding one that seemed appetizing. Rummaging through clear containers of fabrics with other strangers, only for the fabric in question to turn to powder as I grabbed it. Then being chased by a fat woman on a huge tricycle?? Seeing a burning cargo ship far in the distance at sunset, becoming lucid, trying to fly to said plane but getting rammed into by earlier said fat lady on a tricycle??? Dreams are weird.
